personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines, prefers proven methods, and is cautious about adopting unfamiliar ideas too quickly. They are moderately organized, keeping enough structure to stay on track while still adapting when needed, and they usually respond to moral dilemmas by weighing practical consequences, relying on established principles, and seeking a fair middle ground before taking a firm stand if necessary. In group discussions, they speak easily and energetically, often taking initiative in conversation, but they may push back when an idea clashes with their own view or with what feels dependable. They are generally cooperative and socially warm, though they can become somewhat tense under pressure before regaining composure.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
